text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Owie... Guess what happened! I just saw
a girl
over there with an interesting
walk...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umu, I thought to myself, maybe that
walk is the
secret to her speed! What if
she's training her
pivot foot or
something?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So... I tried copying her walk! But while
my eyes
were on her...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I walked into a post—bonk! My
face—bam! Hng...
Maybe I should first
start with watching where I'm
going...
